gap_assessment.bounded_gap: The checked papers do not furnish the proposed comparison of a graph-control package with a strong compulsory non-graph control, matched evidence/recovery/opportunity rights, and one independently scored preselected final artifact under a total resource envelope. Their differing mechanisms and evaluations justify investigating that comparison.
gap_assessment.not_established: Absence of such a comparison across all literature, exact algorithmic novelty or superiority. The 154-source discovery index and prior full-read counts were not re-audited.
gap_assessment.novelty_residual: A task-bounded comparative study and defensible design selection, conditional on actual future measurements; not scoped invalidation, graph lifecycle control, checkpointing, failure retention or tool integration in themselves.
gap_assessment.thesis_to_prototype_fit: Selected references cover epistemic revision, recovery, allocation, active tree/graph control and evaluation construct validity. They support choosing and rejecting mechanisms for a later prototype, while present evidence cannot select a winner or validate the realized product.
